name: Stitch-Troll

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The stitch-troll makes three Rend attacks.

Actions.name: Rend
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Traits.name: Regeneration
Traits.text: The stitch-troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the stitch-troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the stitch-troll's next turn. The stitch-troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.
Traits.clause: knits its wounds shut and keeps coming
answersAlso: knits its wounds shut and keeps coming

Traits.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
Traits.text: If the stitch-troll ends any turn Bloodied and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the stitch-troll's limbs is severed, falls into the stitch-troll's space, and becomes a Troll Limb. The limb acts immediately after the stitch-troll's turn. The stitch-troll has 1 Exhaustion level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains Hit Points.

Bonus Actions.name: Charge
Bonus Actions.text: The stitch-troll moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

lore: Warped from giant flesh by an old tailor-witch's curse, the Stitch-Troll laces its own gashes shut with needles of bone and walks until everything before it lies still.
